instructions: Stay In Touch is a private invite-only family app for grandparents and children. Decisions are recorded as ADRs in docs/decisions/ (index docs/decisions.md) and in docs/architecture.md. Don't suggest a change that contradicts an accepted ADR; say it conflicts with ADR NNNN instead. Access rules live in SQL (RLS and security-definer RPCs with search_path = ''). Free tiers only; nothing that needs a card. Push payloads, logs, and responses must not include message text, captions, photo URLs, or keys.

rules.rule: Do not add Tailwind or utility CSS. Use CSS Modules and the tokens in web/src/styles/tokens.css.
Base text stays at least 20px via var(--text-step-normal).
Interactive targets are at least 48px via var(--size-touch-min).
Use logical CSS properties such as inline-size, block-size, and padding-inline.
Push payloads, service-worker notifications, logs, and function responses must not include message text, captions, photo URLs, or subscription keys.
Do not commit secrets, service-role keys, or VAPID private keys.
